speaker_roles.displayed_role: AppTek reference role where reference_share >= 0.7 (the rule used to select scored customer turns); otherwise the diarization role, flagged as uncertain
speaker_roles.diarization_role: original Pyannote speaker-cluster role mapping, kept unchanged in diarization_role
speaker_roles.mixed_speaker_segment: reference_share < 0.9: the segment contains speech from both parties

sentiment_coverage.rule: closing sentiment coverage is "partial" when scored customer turns end before 90% of the recorded call duration

verified_corrections.policy: Original Qwen3 summary fields stay verbatim in calls_dashboard.csv. Manually verified corrections are published separately with transcript evidence; the app shows the corrected text and labels it.
verified_corrections.evaluation_scores_refer_to: the original model output (rubric scores are unchanged)

redaction.method: rule-based masking of personal identifiers in free-text columns (scripts/redaction.py)

source_provenance.limitations: Speaker roles and sentiment alignment are reference-assisted; models are not rerun.

limitations: Reference labels are required for speaker attribution.
Some Whisper segments may contain mixed speech.
RoBERTa was not trained specifically on call-center conversations.
Manual checks do not establish overall classification accuracy.

definitions.sentiment_polarity: positive_probability - negative_probability per scored customer turn (range -1 to 1)
definitions.sentiment_class_confidence: highest of three probabilities for a scored customer turn; not calibrated call-wide confidence
definitions.sentiment_delta_direction: sign of the supplied call-level sentiment_change score; not a categorical transition and not CSAT
definitions.wer_der_percent: ratios multiplied by 100 for chart labels; lower is better
definitions.qwen_quality: manual quality evaluation scored 1–5; NOT model confidence
